City B decreased from about 35,000 in 1982 to about 30,000 in 1990 and about 25,000 in 2000, showing an obvious and continuous decline. City C roughly remained above 35,000 from 1982 to 2000, and in 2000 it was also slightly higher than in the earlier period, basically not decreasing but increasing instead. Reasoning: The typical manifestation of the suburbanization stage is that the population of the old urban area obviously moves outward to the suburbs, and the population density of the old urban area significantly decreases. Comparing the decrease from 1982 to 2000, the old urban area population density of City B decreased the most obviously and continuously, and most conforms to the characteristics of suburbanization. Therefore the answer is City B.

The urban populations of the three cities in the figure are all above 5 million, and the old urban areas all refer to the scope of the urban areas before the founding of New China. <image1>

From 1982~2000, which city in the figure was in the suburbanization stage?
